authentication_gate.on_401: redirect to deployment-specific sign-in entry or show unauthenticated access message
authentication_gate.on_404: show user record not found screen

routes.description: Default landing page for support agents to find a ticket by search or exact ticket number.
Ticket triage and resolution workspace for a selected ticket.
Shown when authenticated user lacks allowed internal access.
Generic fallback for unknown routes or missing resources when not handled inline.

pages.title: Ticket Lookup
pages.purpose: Allow a support agent to find a support ticket to triage by text search or exact ticket number.
user_stories: As a support agent, I want to search for tickets by text so I can find the issue I need to triage.
As a support agent, I want to jump directly to a ticket when I know the exact ticket number.

data_requirements.name: current_user
data_requirements.needed_for: access confirmation and optional header/profile display

data_requirements.name: ticket_search_results
data_requirements.needed_for: show matching tickets from free-text lookup

data_requirements.name: exact_ticket_lookup
data_requirements.needed_for: navigate directly when exact ticket number is known

api_consumption.usage: Validate internal access when page loads if not already resolved by app shell.
Run text search with required q and optional status filters.
Fetch exact ticket by known ticket number and redirect to detail route on success.

user_actions.result: Enables search submission when q is non-empty.
Narrows search results to selected statuses open, in_progress, resolved.
Calls GET /api/tickets and renders results list with count.
Calls GET /api/tickets/by-number/{ticketNumber}; on success navigates to /tickets/:ticketId.
Navigates to /tickets/:ticketId using selected result id.

loading_states.ui: Full-page spinner or skeleton while validating access via /api/me.
Disable search controls, show results skeleton/loading indicator.
Disable exact lookup button, show inline loader near ticket number field.

error_states.ui: Block app access and send user to deployment-specific sign-in flow or show sign-in required message.
Show blocking message that internal user record was not found.
Show inline validation message prompting for non-empty search text and valid status filters.
Show retry banner and preserve current query/filter input.
Show inline 'ticket not found' message; remain on lookup page.
Show inline validation error for malformed or missing ticket number.

pages.title: Ticket Triage Detail
pages.purpose: Provide the full internal triage workspace for a single ticket, including ticket details, AI guidance, similar resolved tickets, and resolve action.
user_stories: As a support agent, I want to review a ticket's details and AI guidance so I can triage it efficiently.
As a support agent, I want to review similar resolved tickets so I can use prior resolutions as references.
As a support agent, I want to mark a ticket resolved and optionally capture a resolution summary.

data_requirements.name: current_user
data_requirements.needed_for: access validation and optional user display

data_requirements.name: ticket_details
data_requirements.needed_for: header, metadata, full description, current resolution info/status

data_requirements.name: triage_guidance
data_requirements.notes: Can be fetched separately for panel-level loading/refresh, but the same guidance fields are also included in GET /api/tickets/{ticketId}.

data_requirements.name: similar_resolved_tickets
data_requirements.needed_for: reference list of prior resolved tickets
data_requirements.notes: Although GET /api/tickets/{ticketId} returns similar_resolved_ticket_ids, details for display require this dedicated endpoint.

data_requirements.name: resolve_result
data_requirements.needed_for: update UI after marking ticket resolved

api_consumption.usage: Validate access on protected-route entry if not already available.
Primary load for ticket content and current embedded triage guidance.
Optional dedicated fetch for the AI guidance section if the frontend wants panel-level loading or a narrower request.
Load detailed similar resolved ticket cards/list.
Mark the ticket resolved with optional resolution_summary.

user_actions.result: Read ticket subject, description, customer info, product area, priority, status, timestamps, and existing resolution fields if present.
Read generated summary, suggested category, suggested priority, recommended actions, and confidence.
Inspect similar ticket cards/rows with ticket number, subject, product area, priority, resolved_at, resolution_summary, and triage_guidance_summary.
Return to /tickets while preserving optional client-side query state if implemented.
Present optional resolution summary input and confirm action.
Calls POST /api/tickets/{ticketId}/resolve; on success updates status to resolved and displays resolution confirmation.

loading_states.ui: Show page skeleton for ticket header, guidance panel, and similar tickets panel while primary data loads.
Skeleton or placeholder for ticket metadata and description.
Panel-level skeleton if guidance fetched separately.
List/card skeletons in similar resolved tickets section.
Disable resolve controls, show spinner in confirmation button, prevent duplicate submissions.

error_states.ui: Show resource error state with option to go back to lookup.
Show ticket not found empty state with navigation back to lookup.
Handle through app shell auth logic.
Show inline guidance panel error and allow retry; other page sections remain usable.
Show inline similar-tickets panel error and allow retry; other page sections remain usable.
Show inline validation error on resolution summary form.
Show conflict message that ticket is already resolved or cannot be resolved from current state; refresh ticket details.
Show blocking message that ticket no longer exists.
Show high-severity error banner advising retry or support escalation; do not assume final ticket state without re-fetching GET /api/tickets/{ticketId}.

pages.title: Access Denied
pages.purpose: Inform an authenticated user that they are not permitted to use this internal-only POV.
user_stories: As an unauthorized user, I need clear feedback that I cannot access this internal tool.

user_actions.result: Use deployment-specific auth/navigation option outside the API contract.

pages.title: Not Found
pages.purpose: Fallback screen for unknown routes or unresolved navigation targets.
user_stories: As a user, I need a way back when I land on an invalid route.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for creating, editing, or regenerating triage guidance.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Triage guidance must be presented as read-only. Do not offer regenerate/edit actions.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for changing a ticket to in_progress or any status other than resolved.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Do not design workflow controls for intermediate status transitions.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists for listing resolution history or audit events.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Do not include a resolution history timeline beyond the resolve response and current ticket fields.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to fetch full details of an arbitrary similar resolved ticket by id unless the user navigates to that ticket's own /api/tickets/{ticketId} detail.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: The similar resolved tickets panel can show the summary fields returned by GET /similar-resolved-tickets and may link to /tickets/:ticketId only if viewing resolved tickets in the same detail screen is acceptable UX.
